{{Recipe summary
| Category = Duck recipes
| Difficulty = 3
}}

{{recipe}}

They serve this dish all the time in French bistros. By the way, save the fat. Cook your eggs in it in the morning, and they will be amazing!

== Ingredients ==
* 2 boneless [[Cookbook:Duck|duck]] breasts
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]
* Freshly-ground [[Cookbook:Pepper|black pepper]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] Cabernet Sauvignon [[Cookbook:Wine|wine]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Shallot|shallot]], very finely [[Cookbook:Mince|minced]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] finely minced [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]]

== Procedure ==
#Score skin of duck in a diamond pattern and season liberally with salt and freshly ground black pepper. Set aside.
#Heat a 12-inch [[Cookbook:Cast Iron|cast iron]] [[Cookbook:Frying Pan|skillet]] over medium high heat. Add duck breasts, skin side down, and cook 10 minutes. Flip and cook 3 minutes.
#Move pan to a 400°F [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] and cook 12 minutes. Remove duck from pan and keep warm.
#Pour off extra fat. Place 1 Tbsp back into pan and add shallot and garlic. [[Cookbook:Sautéing|Sauté]] over medium high heat until garlic is golden.
#Add wine off of the heat and carefully ignite with a long match or firestick. Shake pan until flames die (might wanna have a fire extinguisher).
#[[Cookbook:Boiling|Boil]] over medium high heat until reduced by half. Drizzle over duck and serve warm.

recipe.name: Pan-Seared Duck Breast with Cabernet Reduction

steps.text: Score skin of duck in a diamond pattern and season liberally with salt and freshly ground black pepper. Set aside.
Heat a 12-inch cast iron skillet over medium high heat. Add duck breasts, skin side down, and cook 10 minutes. Flip and cook 3 minutes.
Move pan to a 400°F oven and cook 12 minutes. Remove duck from pan and keep warm.
Pour off extra fat. Place 1 Tbsp back into pan and add shallot and garlic. Sauté over medium high heat until garlic is golden.
Add wine off of the heat and carefully ignite with a long match or firestick. Shake pan until flames die (might wanna have a fire extinguisher).
Boil over medium high heat until reduced by half. Drizzle over duck and serve warm.
